
```{r}
#| label: precision-by-trials
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4
if (!("sme_uv" %in% names(qual)) || all(is.na(qual$sme_uv))) {
  cat("\nNo SME was exported for this dataset, so precision against trial count cannot be shown.\n\n")
} else {
  d <- qual %>% filter(!is.na(sme_uv), !is.na(n_trials), n_trials > 0)
  d$n_surviving <- d$n_trials - ifelse(is.na(d$n_trials_rejected), 0, d$n_trials_rejected)
  d <- d %>% filter(n_surviving > 0)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    cat("\nNo subject had both an SME and a surviving trial count.\n\n")
  } else {
    # The curve is anchored on the median subject rather than fitted: it is
    # the shape precision MUST follow if trials are independent, not a
    # regression through these points, and fitting it would let a noisy
    # sample bend the reference it is being judged against.
    ref_n <- median(d$n_surviving, na.rm = TRUE)
    ref_s <- median(d$sme_uv, na.rm = TRUE)
    curve <- data.frame(n_surviving = seq(max(1, min(d$n_surviving)), max(d$n_surviving), length.out = 100))
    curve$sme_uv <- ref_s * sqrt(ref_n) / sqrt(curve$n_surviving)

    p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = n_surviving, y = sme_uv)) +
      geom_line(data = curve, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_point(aes(colour = bin), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.8) +
      labs(x = "surviving trials", y = "SME (uV)", colour = "bin",
           caption = "dashed line: the 1/sqrt(n) improvement independent trials give") +
      alz_theme()
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")

    above <- d %>% mutate(expected = ref_s * sqrt(ref_n) / sqrt(n_surviving)) %>%
             filter(sme_uv > 1.5 * expected)
    if (nrow(above) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf(paste("\n%d subject-bin-channel combination(s) sit more than half again above the curve.",
                        "Those are noisy within their trials rather than short of them, so collecting more",
                        "trials would not bring them into line.\n\n"), nrow(above)))
    } else {
      cat(paste("\nEvery combination sits close to the curve, so precision here is limited by trial",
                "count rather than by anything unusual within the trials.\n\n"))
    }
  }
}
```
